name: Valgan's Field
summary: Worgen roam Valgan's Field above Lordamere Lake in northern Silverpine Forest. Arugal unleashed the Moonrage pack, and the Forsaken now search the ruined farm for his abandoned research.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: West of the Shining Strand and north of the nearby river, Valgan's Field overlooks Lordamere Lake. The wheat farm once prospered, until the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and forced Valgan to flee or die. Left untended, its buildings fell to feral Moonrage worgen prowling down from Shadowfang Keep. Before the Third War, Arugal spent time here and left remnants of his arcane research. Now the Forsaken seek them.

faq.answer: Valgan was the human farmer who owned and worked the homestead before the Third War. When the Scourge swept across northern Lordaeron, he either died or fled into exile, leaving the farm to ruin.

faq.q: Why are worgen roaming Valgan's Field?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal summoned the feral Moonrage pack into Silverpine Forest and unleashed the beasts against the Scourge. He quickly lost control as they spread through the forest, and guilt drove him mad.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken interested in this farm?
aliases: why forsaken care about valgans field
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal lived at the farm before the war and left valuable spellbooks behind. The Forsaken seek the lost writings to understand and counter his terrifying magic.

faq.q: What rare threats appear near the farm?
faq.answer: Moonrage worgen packs are the farm's chief menace. No other notable threat is known to haunt its fields.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, clearing Valgan's Field is essential to securing the road through Silverpine and recovering Arugal's notes before his monstrous pets spread farther north.
Arugal's abandoned research at the farm warns of the catastrophic perils of unchecked summoning and extraplanar magic.
